invariants.rationale: The layer parameter is used throughout the method, so it must not be null at the exit.
The function returns early if layer.getTextureRegion() == null, so at method exit this expression must hold.
Parallax factors for X are typically non-negative in tile map rendering.
Parallax factors for Y are typically non-negative in tile map rendering.
If the layer is visible, then the texture region must not be null for rendering to proceed.
